== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Wes Janson (Japanese)|Wes Janson]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/152940005/k3uIJT8K70CjuxY_yBoEdg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 86099780.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>91265f45e156835f0bb7311dd18a1be3d5217b8d3852caa7954eb0204d1f2a24</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
